sentences.text: 08 . This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Heard Mr. Panda, learned Counsel for the Appellants and Mr. Pattanaik, learned Additional Standing Counsel for the Respondent.
3.

The present Appeal has been preferred under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894,
shortly, L.A. Act, 1894 challenging common judgment dated 13.04.1998 passed by the Civil Judge (Senior Division), Bhadrak (hereinafter referred to as "referral court"), in L.A. Misc. Case Nos. 372,
392, and 393, all of 1996.

entities.text:
L.A. Misc. Case Nos. 372,
392, and 393, all of 1996
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: But, this Appeal is confined to judgment passed in L.A. Misc. Case No.392 of 1996.

4. Learned Counsel for the Appellants submits, this Appeal is covered by the judgments passed by the coordinate Bench in LAA No.4 of 2012 and LAA No.143 of 2010, both dated 20.06.2022.
5.

Since copies of the said judgments were also supplied to the learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State- Respondent, after examining the said judgments, Mr. Pattanaik fairly concedes before this court that the present Appeal is squarely covered by the said judgments passed in LAA No.4 of 2012, so also LAA No.144 of 2010, kissam of the land in question being same and situated in the same village as that of LAA No. 4 of 2012 and LAA No.144 of 2010.
6. Accordingly, this Appeal stands disposed of holding that the Appellants are entitled to compensation @ Rs.1,50,000/- per acre for acquiring land of Ac.0.25 decimals .

The compensation Lalatendu Mohapatra And vs Land Acquisition Collector on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157610115/
1 be computed and paid to the Appellants at the said rate with all other statutory benefits in terms of L.A.Act, 1894 within a period of six weeks from the date of communication/production of the certified copy of this order.
